products.name: SAP Joule
products.note: ERP copilot across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba; Joule Studio for custom agents; Knowledge Graph integration; ledger-modification risk

reading.body:
SAP is a 1972-founded public enterprise software company headquartered in Walldorf, Germany whose primary AI product is Joule, a copilot embedded across its core ERP and HR platforms, with tooling for custom agent development and knowledge graph integration.

Joule's position inside S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba means AI inference runs against live operational data, including financial ledgers. The explicit note on ledger-modification risk signals that SAP has acknowledged a category of harm specific to agentic systems acting on authoritative business records, a concern that does not arise the same way in consumer AI products.

The twelve MCP connectors listed span analytics, messaging, trend data, e-commerce signals, and a Solana-native payments gateway. They describe how external agents can reach SAP data or adjacent commercial signals, not how SAP's own infrastructure is provisioned. The data covers product surface and ecosystem integrations, and does not address compute capacity, data center footprint, or power sourcing, so no inference about SAP's position in the compute or energy supply chain is supported here.
